Silly Cat

A downloadable game for Windows

Download NowName your own price

Silly Cat is a short horror game with multiple endings about Chris, left home alone while his parents are away for the night. There’s a cat in the house.

Except Chris doesn’t have a cat.

A short, focused horror with no filler I made in about a week using Unreal Engine.
